name: CivicBridge English-Hindi demonstration corpus
description: Hand-authored fictional civic reports for demonstrating a training pipeline. Not collected from citizens; not a production benchmark.

train: Garbage collection trucks skip narrow lanes and mixed waste piles up near homes.
The landfill is overflowing with plastic waste and needs recycling segregation.
Food scraps and household rubbish are dumped beside the market every evening.
Residents need separate bins for wet waste and dry recyclable materials.
Municipal sanitation workers cannot collect overflowing community dustbins.
Plastic packaging and discarded bottles block the neighborhood waste collection point.
कूड़े का ढेर सड़क पर पड़ा है और कचरा उठाने वाली गाड़ी नहीं आती।
बाजार में प्लास्टिक और गीले कचरे को अलग करने के लिए डिब्बे चाहिए।
test: Uncollected garbage fills the bins outside our homes; we need reliable waste pickup.
मोहल्ले में कचरा उठाने की व्यवस्था खराब है और प्लास्टिक के ढेर लगे हैं।

train: The village borewell runs dry each summer and families need drinking water storage.
Leaking water supply pipes waste thousands of litres before reaching households.
Rainwater harvesting and groundwater recharge could restore the drying village well.
Residents depend on unreliable water tankers during the severe summer shortage.
The drinking water reservoir has low levels and needs conservation monitoring.
Broken taps continuously leak potable water near the community standpipe.
गांव में पीने के पानी की कमी है और कुआं सूख गया है।
बारिश के पानी का संग्रह और भूजल संरक्षण गांव के लिए जरूरी है।
test: A dry borewell and delayed tankers leave village households without drinking water.
गांव में पानी के टैंकर समय पर नहीं आते और पीने का पानी नहीं मिलता।

train: The primary school lacks classrooms and students study outside during the rain.
Teachers need offline digital learning material for children without internet access.
Village students cannot access a library or affordable learning resources.
The school roof is damaged and the classrooms need repair before lessons resume.
Children leave school because there are no accessible toilets or learning support.
Local teachers request science laboratory equipment for secondary school classes.
स्कूल की कक्षाएं टूटी हुई हैं और बच्चों को पढ़ने की जगह नहीं मिलती।
छात्रों के लिए पुस्तकालय और डिजिटल शिक्षा की सुविधा चाहिए।
test: Students need safe classrooms and an offline library of school learning materials.
स्कूल में बच्चों के लिए प्रयोगशाला और पढ़ाई की सामग्री उपलब्ध नहीं है।

train: The rural clinic lacks doctors and patients travel far for basic consultations.
Community health workers need tools to schedule medical referrals in remote villages.
The hospital has long waiting times and no reliable patient appointment system.
Pregnant women cannot access regular medical checkups at the primary health centre.
Residents need medicine availability information for nearby public clinics.
Vaccination outreach teams need an offline system to follow up with patients.
गांव के अस्पताल में डॉक्टर नहीं हैं और मरीजों को दूर जाना पड़ता है।
स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में दवा और चिकित्सा जांच की सुविधा नहीं मिलती।
test: Patients need a local clinic referral and appointment service when doctors are absent.
अस्पताल में मरीजों के लिए दवा और डॉक्टर की उपलब्धता की जानकारी चाहिए।

train: Deep potholes damage vehicles on the main road and repairs are overdue.
Broken streetlights leave residential streets dark after sunset.
The public bridge has cracks and needs a structural inspection and repair.
Stormwater drains overflow because the drainage infrastructure is damaged.
The village footpath and public buildings need wheelchair ramps.
Damaged road surfaces and missing pavements make the neighborhood hard to navigate.
सड़क पर गहरे गड्ढे हैं और पुल की मरम्मत जरूरी है।
गली की स्ट्रीट लाइट खराब है और नाली टूट गई है।
test: The streetlights and roadside drains are broken and need municipal repair.
गांव की सड़क और फुटपाथ टूटे हुए हैं और मरम्मत की जरूरत है।

train: Small farmers need soil moisture sensors to irrigate crops without wasting electricity.
Crop diseases spread because growers cannot obtain timely agricultural advice.
Farmers need affordable irrigation scheduling based on soil and crop conditions.
Village growers cannot find reliable market prices for harvested produce.
Soil testing equipment would help farmers choose suitable crop nutrients.
An irrigation pump fails frequently and leaves the farms without sufficient crop watering.
किसानों को फसल की सिंचाई और मिट्टी की नमी की जानकारी चाहिए।
खेत की फसल में बीमारी है और किसान को कृषि सलाह नहीं मिलती।
test: Farmers want soil sensors and agricultural advice to improve crop irrigation.
किसान को मिट्टी की जांच और फसल की सिंचाई के लिए सस्ती तकनीक चाहिए।

train: Industrial smoke pollutes the neighborhood air and residents need air quality monitoring.
The local forest is losing trees and community volunteers want a replanting plan.
A polluted lake needs ecological restoration and biodiversity monitoring.
Construction dust worsens air pollution near residential buildings.
Urban trees are being cut without a plan to restore green cover.
Residents want reliable measurements of industrial emissions and local air quality.
कारखाने के धुएं से वायु प्रदूषण बढ़ रहा है और पेड़ कम हो रहे हैं।
झील में प्रदूषण है और पर्यावरण संरक्षण के लिए निगरानी चाहिए।
test: Air pollution from factory smoke and construction dust needs independent monitoring.
शहर में पेड़ों की कटाई और वायु प्रदूषण से पर्यावरण को नुकसान हो रहा है।

train: Women feel unsafe walking home because harassment is frequent near the station.
Residents need a reliable way to report crime and unsafe public spaces.
Poor emergency response coordination makes the neighborhood unsafe at night.
Children face safety risks from unsecured abandoned buildings near the playground.
The community wants safer public spaces and a confidential harassment reporting channel.
A missing emergency warning system leaves residents unaware of local safety threats.
महिलाओं की सुरक्षा के लिए छेड़छाड़ की शिकायत की व्यवस्था चाहिए।
मोहल्ले में अपराध बढ़ रहे हैं और लोगों को सुरक्षा की चिंता है।
test: Repeated harassment and crime make the public park unsafe for women after dark.
लोगों को अपराध की शिकायत और आपातकालीन सुरक्षा सहायता की सुविधा चाहिए।

train: City buses are inaccessible to wheelchair users and elderly commuters.
Passengers need reliable bus arrival times and accessible route planning.
Traffic congestion makes daily commuting unpredictable on the main bus corridor.
Public transport routes do not connect the village to nearby employment centres.
Bus stops lack route information and accessible boarding points for passengers.
Commuters need coordinated last-mile transport between the railway station and homes.
बस यात्रियों को समय और मार्ग की सही जानकारी नहीं मिलती।
सार्वजनिक परिवहन में दिव्यांग यात्रियों के लिए सुलभ बसों की जरूरत है।
test: Commuters need accessible buses and dependable public transport arrival information.
गांव से शहर तक बस सेवा और यात्रियों के लिए मार्ग की जानकारी चाहिए।

train: Residents need a community noticeboard for local volunteer activities.
The neighborhood needs an accessible way to coordinate community events.
People want help understanding how to apply for public services and certificates.
Local artisans need a shared space to promote traditional crafts and community culture.
Volunteers struggle to coordinate donations of unused household goods.
Senior residents want a community companionship and social activity network.
मोहल्ले में सामुदायिक कार्यक्रम और स्वयंसेवकों का समन्वय करना है।
स्थानीय कलाकारों को अपनी कला दिखाने के लिए सामुदायिक मंच चाहिए।
test: Neighbors want a volunteer network to organize community events and share donated goods.
स्थानीय स्वयंसेवकों को सामुदायिक कार्यक्रम की जानकारी साझा करने का मंच चाहिए।
